name: MonIA Reference Vault
purpose: Single persistent binary store for all canonical user-supplied character references used by MonIA.
rules: Every durable photo, video or audio reference must have one vault ref_id.
Reference banks store vault ids and semantic roles, not expiring chat URLs.
GPU workers receive only selected vault binaries for the current shot.
Vault binaries never become narrative output and are never copied shot-for-shot.
If a required vault asset is missing, generation fails closed.
